color term describing the other component of the mixture
indicates equal proportion in the mixture

compound denoting the resulting form or appearance; bakula+asya is genitive relation within compound

items.question: What resulting appearance arises from mixing red and yellow in equal measure?
premises: Red is one component of the mixture.
Yellow is the other component of the mixture.
The two components are mixed in equal measure.
The resulting mixture has the shape of a bakula fruit.
items.inference: An equal mixture of red and yellow produces an appearance likened to the shape of a bakula fruit.
uncertainties: Whether ākṛtiḥ refers primarily to shape or to overall appearance/color-form is not fully explicit.
items.plain_english: Red and yellow mixed in equal parts have the form of a bakula fruit.
